about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in a surreal and dreamlike world? Explore 5 unique maps filled with hand-drawn surreal landscapes, strange shapes, and mind-bending scenes. Discover cats hiding in these scenes and color each one by numbers to add color to this mystical dream realm!

Each map offers a detailed and unique surreal dream atmosphere with magical and mysterious vibes. Can you find the cats hidden in this fantastic world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Explore this mysterious world with the relaxing power of colors and dreamlike ambiance!

✨ Features:

🌙 5 unique surreal dream maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed surreal dream radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
